name: Han 2026 Sim2Real-PK daratumumab public ODE scenarios
description: Exact source-code/result replay plus source-limited dynamic ODE scenarios for the public daratumumab synthetic generator.

scenarios.name: Source parameters and paper performance metrics exact replay
scenarios.description: Zero-dose exact replay of the public daratumumab ODE parameters and reported Sim2Real-PK performance endpoints.

scenarios.name: 16 mg/kg single-dose public ODE exposure anchor
scenarios.description: Public ODE short-horizon single-dose daratumumab trajectory used as one point in a dose-exposure scan. Paper Fig. 2E only reports the fitted exponent/R2, not extractable per-dose AUC points.

scenarios.name: 16 mg/kg label-like public ODE therapeutic-window overlay
scenarios.description: Early label-like 16 mg/kg IV induction-window schedule using the public ODE and median infusion durations, overlaid with paper Fig. 5A trough/peak constraints.

scenarios.name: Low-albumin 16 mg/kg public ODE covariate overlay
scenarios.description: A covariate perturbation from the public ODE showing albumin-dependent clearance direction; paper/SI provides qualitative covariate sensitivity but not digitizable coordinates.
